name: Horonobe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Horonobe town emblem in orange and white: an orange six-pointed star within a white outlined ring.
history: Municipal flag of Horonobe, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 19 April 1968.

features.role: Horonobe town emblem — an orange six-pointed star within a white outlined ring
